text:
SY210
Social Inequality
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
A critical examination of the processes and dynamics of various forms of inequality. Key areas of social inequality to be addressed will include the following: race/ethnicity, gender, class, sexuality/sexual orientation, age, ability/disability.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY101
or
SY103
Exclusions
SY204*, SY301.
